gate1.baseline_source: accepted exp-20260530-007 FINRA/IWM paper overlay on docs/backtesting.md PIT-DTE core baselines

gate3.note: No core production filter was added; default-off paper support only.

gate4.rationale: FINRA/IWM cost-liquidity support passed Gate 4 and is retained in the shared default-off FINRA adapter without live/default order changes.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation / default-off paper allocation: already-selected FINRA/IWM entries with high dollar liquidity and contained range may have better cost-adjusted replacement value. This matches the playbook's FINRA cost-adjusted liquidity opening and avoids score/IWM/cooldown retunes.

2_history_check.exp-20260529-004: Accepted VBB cost-liquidity support on a different default-off paper sleeve; useful mechanism evidence, not a same-sleeve duplicate.
2_history_check.exp-20260530-007: Accepted FINRA/IWM same-ticker cooldown candidate pool; target sample is 38 rows and all FINRA score/IWM/cooldown rules stay fixed.
2_history_check.exp-20260530-010: Shared FINRA adapter accepted; this run does not retune adapter thresholds.
2_history_check.exp-20260601-017: Rejected consensus liquidity-efficiency gate; that was a different source family and a gate, not FINRA support.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three PIT-DTE windows; require aggregate EV/PnL positive, all windows EV/PnL improved, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, survival >=5%, >=10 supported rows across all 3 windows, and concentration guards.

hypothesis: Accepted FINRA/IWM same-ticker cooldown paper candidates may deserve modest notional support when signal-day dollar liquidity is high and signal-day range is contained, proxying lower execution friction and cleaner breakout demand.
interpretation: FINRA/IWM cost-liquidity support passed Gate 4 and is retained in the shared default-off FINRA adapter without live/default order changes.
next_retry_requires: forward replacement-value rows before live activation
a materially distinct FINRA execution-quality field before nearby threshold/scalar retunes

production_impact.promotion_requirement: Forward live activation still requires closed replacement-value evidence and a separate Gate 1-4 live adapter experiment.

ticket.acceptance_rule: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window before/after; aggregate EV and PnL positive; all three windows EV and PnL improve; supported sample >=10 across all 3 windows; drawdown drift <=0.5pp; survival >=5%; concentration guards pass.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Create the ticket under registry lock before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

ticket.hypothesis: Accepted FINRA/IWM same-ticker cooldown paper candidates with high signal-day dollar liquidity and contained signal-day range may have better cost-adjusted replacement value without retuning FINRA score, IWM confirmation, cooldown, ranking, or hold.

prediction.confidence_reason: Playbook freezes FINRA score/IWM/cooldown retunes but explicitly leaves cost-adjusted liquidity/fill-delay diagnostics open; accepted FINRA sample is only 38 rows, so incremental edge may be thin.
